configuration.storage: persistent Map, no Web Storage or disk I/O
configuration.clock: deterministic wall and monotonic clocks; timestamps compared in full

method.timing: Elapsed wall time and process CPU user+system. No browser FPS, GPU time or main-thread-only measurement. Only constant-size storage read/write tallies remain in timing mode; traversal counters, byte scans and phase wrappers are diagnostic-only.
method.cold: First invocation in a fresh game VM, before warmup. repeated/mutated-save: initially empty slot; repeated-read: fresh reader over a prepopulated slot; store-prepopulated-first-write: fresh store before every write.
method.verification: Full raw strings and parsed records compared exactly at cold/final checkpoints; full payload/result hashes and timestamps compared for every measured sample. Full guardable snapshot, physical bodies and clocks compared after each pair. Verification and preparation are outside each timed operation.
method.diagnostics: Counters/profile separately wrap production functions in memory only. JSON traversal counts include recursive nodes; profile timings are inclusive/nested and must not be summed. Timing mode uses unchanged production source, apart from test harness exports.
method.retention: Sample output retains bounded hashes, not every serialized scene. Two full raw/parsed checkpoints per variant are retained until pair comparison; no heap-byte or GC claim is made.
method.percentiles: Nearest rank per repetition. With 24 samples p95 is rank23 and p99 is rank24; short runs do not establish long-tail behavior.
method.budget: Eight seconds by default per variant/case, including setup, warmup, measurement and checks between atomic operations. Never interrupts Cannon or a storage operation midway.
